title: O standing still
blurb: The sanity check: O does not move. 2 inner players start shielded. 6 D players clear the outer 6 in tick 1, which exposes the rest, and finish in tick 2.

title: Moving O, 12 players
blurb: O flees the nearest D player while holding its formation. Tick 1 strips the outer players and exposes the 2 shielded ones; 6 D players win in 2 ticks.

title: Moving O, 20 players
blurb: The largest formation size, with 5 players shielded at the start. 11 D players take the outer 10 in tick 1 and the last 10 in tick 2.

title: Without the nerve
blurb: Each D player hits its nearest O player with no coordination. 3 hits land on players someone else already took, and one O player survives.

title: With the nerve
blurb: Same formation, same 7 D players. Targets are matched across the nerve, so no hit is wasted and D wins in 2 ticks.

title: A formation D cannot win
blurb: O stands still in 3 layers. Even with 20 D players, one per O player, peeling needs 3 rounds and there are only 2 ticks: 2 O players survive.
